newsitem.title: FRANCE: French May CAC-40 future suspended limit down.
newsitem.headline: French May CAC-40 future suspended limit down.

text.p: The May CAC-40 future contract was briefly suspended limit-down after falling 120 points to 2,558, the Matif confirmed on Wednesday.
After requoting, it was down 112 points at 2,566 at 1047 GMT.
The stock market plunged on talk of privately commissioned polls giving the opposition Socialists a parliamentary majority in Sunday's runoff election, brokers said.
